OPERATOR CONSOLE — desktop 1440x900
Main/Children/Routes are the same map-first shell as Console below, each opened to its own tab by default — kept as separate pages for reference, Console is the real interactive one.

CONSOLE V3 — desktop 1440x900, interactive
Map is the full-bleed base layer (persists across all three sections). A slim icon-only rail floats left (Live map / Children / Routes & zones, max 3), a white content panel floats right next to it — both cards over the map, no opaque columns. Children is a scrollable list, no table. Click a rail icon to switch.

This is the canonical version — do not edit the other three from here without also checking here.

LOGIN — desktop 1440x900
Wide-viewport sign-in exploration, paired with ParentLogin (mobile). Not part of the operator console.

PARENT APP — mobile 390x844
Active ride, lost signal, quiet state, sign-in.

ParentLive and ParentStale are the same moment of the same ride. Without the second one a dead feed looks identical to a healthy one.

Names, schools, phone numbers, IMEI and coordinates are sample values — replace with real data before this goes in front of the client.

The only real facts here: the gym's address and front-desk number from the website.
